MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.205

2. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. They are equal

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

5. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 100
   C. 11
   D. 50

6. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 30
   C. 21
   D. 42

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 34
   B. 17
   C. 22
   D. 66

9. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
